rounds.prompt: Name as many countries that have hosted the men's FIFA World Cup as you can.
rounds.blurb: Every host from Uruguay 1930 to the 2026 World Cup. Co-hosts count.
rounds.fact: Chile hosted in 1962, two years after the 1960 Valdivia earthquake, the strongest ever recorded.
